subject: Atlas: expansion handoff — burst capacity, term change, and QBR timing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@atlashealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas: expansion handoff — burst capacity, term change, and QBR timing

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I wanted to put a short kickoff email on the thread so we can align timeline, stakeholders, and immediate next steps for the proposed Q2 expansion (burst capacity + revised term). High-level asks and proposals below: 

- What: Add a 3-month burst pool (on top of existing committed capacity) and move from a 12-month to an 18-month term to smooth pricing and enable the burst at a lower unit rate.
- Why: You mentioned seasonal traffic spikes in late Q2 and a preference to lock a predictable rate for the next 18 months.
- Ballpark pricing: preliminary estimate attached — expect a blended unit range (generation tokens) of $0.012–$0.016 per 1k tokens for the bumped commit, with burst pricing at ~1.6x of the committed unit. Final pricing will depend on confirmed commit size.
- Stakeholders: From Redwood: me (AE), Monica (CS lead), Rishi (platform/solutions). From Atlas: Susan (ML product), Tom (SRE), procurement. Please add any other stakeholders.
- Timeline (proposed):
  - This week: confirm QBR date window and any procurement constraints
  - By Mar 10: finalize M.A.P. and target commit numbers
  - Mar 15–22: internal approvals & PO issuance
  - Mar 25: target roll/availability of burst capacity

Requested next steps: please confirm which QBR week works for your execs (we've got open slots Mar 20–23) and whether procurement needs a specific PO format. I've attached a short mutual action plan and a capacity worksheet to help size the commit.

Attachments: Atlas_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf, capacity_burst_estimate.xlsx (see attached stubs)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Atlas: expansion handoff — burst capacity, term change, and QBR timing

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments — appreciate the proactive handoff. A couple quick items from our side: 

- QBR: Mar 22 (Thursday) works best for our execs; please reserve a 45-minute slot starting 10:00am PT.
- Commit sizing: tentatively looking at +50% committed capacity during the 3-month burst window. We'll confirm numbers after Tom validates operational impact.
- Pricing: will the blended rate you shared ($0.012–$0.016 per 1k tokens) be fixed if we move to an 18-month term? If not fixed, what are the guardrails? We need that for procurement to approve the PO.
- Procurement: procurement@atlashealth.com — they need a commercial term sheet and preferred PO format (they prefer a PO referencing the Redwood SOW and a standard net-30). Please also flag any auto-renewal language.

On the call they mentioned being cautious about auto-renewal language; procurement will want explicit renewal opt-in.

Susan / Tom / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming Mar 22. Summary of agreed items and immediate deliverables from Redwood: 

1) QBR: scheduled for Thu Mar 22, 10:00–10:45am PT — I will send the calendar invite and agenda by end of day Monday (Mar 6).
2) Pricing guardrails: if Atlas signs an 18-month commitment, we will hold the committed blended unit price within the $0.012–$0.016 per 1k token range (final rate depends on the final commit band). Burst capacity will be charged at 1.6x the committed unit rate; we will include a cap on monthly burst spend in the M.A.P. so procurement has protection from runaway usage.
3) Procurement pack: attached is a short commercial term sheet + the mutual action plan. Procurement, we included a sample SOW reference and explicit non-auto-renewal language — please let me know if you need any edits for your PO template.
4) Next steps for Atlas: confirm the exact commit number for the 3-month burst by Mar 10 so we can lock pricing and provision lead times.

Attachments (stubs): Atlas_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf, capacity_burst_estimate.xlsx
DocuSign/contract link (draft term sheet): https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123-atl-burst
Internal reference: https://redwood.docs.internal/mutual-action-plan/DEAL-ATL-2028-03

If it helps, Rishi will draft a short ops-runbook paragraph describing burst provisioning and a rollback plan (graceful degrade to smaller model variants) ahead of the QBR.

Thanks all — looking forward to the meeting.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
